verdicts_or_reports.expected: Opening "Browse cards" for the French deck should open the card browser filtered to French, showing 3 cards ("French" | "3 cards shown").
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Opening "Browse cards" for the French deck reuses the previously remembered browser deck instead: the toolbar shows "Spanish" | "4 cards shown" and lists the Spanish cards (agua, comer, hola, mesa).
steps: Open Card browser from the drawer and set the deck filter to Spanish (toolbar shows 'Spanish' | '4 cards shown').
Press Back to return to the deck list.
Long-press the French deck and choose 'Browse cards'.
Observe the browser opens with deck filter 'Spanish' and the 4 Spanish cards, not French.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: Swept deck list and card browser plus tags. Tested: deck list counts (French 3, Spanish 4, total 7); expand/collapse arrows created via temporary subdecks and verified per-deck independence plus persistence of collapsed and expanded states across navigation, rotation and app restart; deck picker search ("Filter decks") filtering as each character is typed, deletion, clear, case-insensitivity and empty-result handling; card browser deck filter correctness (All decks 7, French 3, Spanish 4), Search all decks action, display-order sorting asc/desc, rotation; tag dialog union behavior with one and two distinct tags and with both selection orders (verb on comer, noun on mesa => both checked; untagged rows unchecked), add tag, cancel/confirm reversal, check/uncheck all, filter tags, multi-row tag application and removal, note-editor tag consistency, tag:verb search. Data was restored to the preconditions afterwards (subdecks deleted, extra tags purged via Check database, only verb on comer). One bug found and confirmed/logged by the developer: launching "Browse cards" for a deck (e.g. French) reuses the last browser-state deck (Spanish) instead of the requested deck. No other defects found.
